source: Skeleton supplied with TTWVR 1.1.6; not redistributed
method: Compose parent transforms in the supplied reference skeleton. Check R_target = reflect_body_right * R_source * reflect_local_Z and mirrored bone origins. Upper-body mesh orientations were also compared. These checks describe reference frames, not live tracked poses.
reference_scale_note: 70 skeleton units/metre for the approximate preview; does not read/write user calibration

direction_correction.conversion: diag(1,-1,1) applied to origins and rotation rows after native-frame orthonormalization
direction_correction.previous_limitation: The bilateral mirror checks above did not validate front/back. Field Kit 1.1–1.3 mislabeled native +Y as back.
